positions.title: Software Engineer Cyber GRC
positions.description:
As a key contributor within Chevron’s Cyber IRM ART DevOps team, I specialize in delivering end-to-end solutions across ServiceNow’s GRC module to support governance, risk, and compliance initiatives. My role focuses on both platform development and process optimization to support secure and compliant operations.

Core Responsibilities & Achievements:

Designed and maintained GRC components, including Business Applications, Entities, ACRs, Controls, Control Indicators, Policy Exceptions, Remediation Tasks, and Issue Rating Calculations.

Developed critical ServiceNow customizations: Scheduled Jobs, Script Includes, Email Notifications, UI Policies, Business Rules, and UI Actions.

Led modernization of the Issues Module, streamlining workflows for Policy Exceptions and Remediation Tasks.

Automated Control Indicator kickoff and Issue Rating calculations to increase accuracy and reduce manual intervention.

Spearheaded the migration and enhancement of the Cyber Assurance Tool (CAT) from SharePoint to Dataverse, improving team collaboration.

Developed Power Automate flows to optimize weekly change management processes.

Created scheduled scripts to monitor key risk activities, such as suspicious data deletions, profile generation timing, and sync errors.

Implemented UI enhancements for the Issue Form, improving usability and experience.

Built Power Apps to automate business processes, supporting operational efficiency.

Developed Control Indicator Templates (basic and scripted) for regulatory compliance tracking.

Supported GRC incidents and task requests, ensuring timely issue resolution.

Led upgrade activities for ServiceNow instances (Washington DC and Yokohama releases).

Contributed to the Automated Testing Framework with reusable test cases and suites.

Currently pursuing ServiceNow Administrator certification to deepen platform expertise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was hired as a Senior Software Engineer and ScrumMaster for an ecommerce retailer company. My last duty involved setting up an Agile Scrum environment for Software Development Projects from scratch, providing Agile concepts to employees, structuring sprints from 0, Definition of Done, Planning, Review, Retrospective Events, among others. Previously, I was part of a team of developers working on a customer portal to submit payments and to electronically approve sent quotes using Ionic/Angular for mobile experience and front end as well as Cloud Mongo dB for Database management and Nodejs to handle REST API. Unit and Functional testing was done accordingly using Jasmine/Karma and Protractor, also with test coverage of 80% of total code. Previously, I worked to create and connect Webhooks and serverless functions to funnel Zoho CRM and all Lead Sales from advertising and Website, also worked on automation of data, tasks, and workflow within the CRM

positions.title: Senior Software/QA Engineer
positions.description:
Hired as a Senior Software Engineer to be assigned to different clients projects, being an Agile Scrum developer team member, and also being rotated between Front End, Back End,  and QA testing roles.

Major Airline Company based at Atlanta, GA
Senior Frontend & QA Test Developer 	Mar 2020 - Aug 2020 
Front End developing using Angular 8, some Ionic, also functional testing using Cucumber for a customer support dashboard. Agile Scrum ceremonies were part of my daily activities.

Major Airline Company based at Dallas TX
Technical Module Lead – DevOps/Front End Developer	Nov 2016 - Feb 2020
Front end development, code review, unit testing and deployment of different web applications using mostly Angular, React, and Jasmine/Karma for unit testing purposes. Also, I participated as part of the DevOps team writing scripts to automate deployment processes in servers. Previously I was assigned to developing a DevOps Services Dashboard to control and support deployed versions of different Web Apps Java services, starting or stopping services, running deployments or un-deployments using Jenkins jobs. I have mostly coded using Angular, or any JavaScript related framework/library. We delivered a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) using SAFE Agile Scrum methodology with two weeks of sprints, Grooming, Planning, Stand Ups, Demos, and Retrospective as part of Agile Events. Also, I worked as a Substitute ScrumMaster during his vacation.  We mostly used JIRA as a Project management tool.

Major Insurance Company based at Milwaukee, WI
Senior Software Engineer/QA Tester	Jan 2016 - Nov 2016
My duties involved performing functional testing based on Apple products using Swift. I also participated in developing test plans, test cases, documented test results, and worked actively detecting defects or any bugs during software development.
